declared_area_note: The applicant's note (capture evalenv-doc-417114-paray-rnt.pdf, page 6) states that the project covers 29,655 m2 on part of the single cadastral parcel AB 53, owned by Air France; API Carto returns 91479000AB0053 with a contenance of 33,721 m2, so the project occupies about 88% of the parcel. The note bounds the site by rue des Avernaises (north), avenue du Maréchal Devaux (east), rue Jean Mermoz (south) and rue Marcel Albert (west); the BAN point of 1 avenue du Maréchal Devaux lies 27.5 m east of the parcel, on the avenue, and the Géorisques point of the Air France real-estate record lies 78 m south of it.
